title: Concurrency vs Sequential Await
goal: Sequential await pauses execution step by step, while concurrent execution polls multiple futures together.

sections.text: Awaiting a future pauses the current function until that future completes. If you await two futures one after the other, they run in sequence, not at the same time.

sections.code:
let a = fetch_a().await;
let b = fetch_b().await;
sections.caption: Sequential .await runs tasks one after another.

sections.text: To run futures concurrently on an executor, both futures must exist at the same time and be polled together.
Combining futures into a single execution step lets the executor make progress on whichever one is ready. Sequential awaits delay starting the second future until the first is completely finished.

explanation: Sequential await pauses execution step by step, while concurrent execution polls multiple futures together.
